app.name: Helpdesk Power Suite: Cursor Export & Field Rules
app.short_description: Export 50,000+ tickets, users & orgs to CSV/Excel with custom fields — and hide, lock or require ticket fields per group, role or tag by field name, with zero flicker.
app.long_description:
**Advanced Cursor Search & Export**

- No 1,000-result wall: cursor pagination streams every page of tickets, users and organizations (50,000+ rows).
- Include archived tickets with one toggle.
- Every custom ticket, user and organization field exported under its human-readable title.
- Filter users by active vs. suspended, role (Admin / Agent / Light agent / End-user) and tag inclusion/exclusion.
- Strict de-duplication by ID: switching tabs or retrying never duplicates rows.
- Resizable columns and sticky column presets.
- 1-click UTF-8 CSV (opens cleanly in Excel) or styled multi-column .xlsx.

**Visual Field Rules (no numeric field IDs)**

- Pick fields by name, build rules per group, per role and per tag.
- Hide, make read-only, require, or set a value — ordered by priority, with override rules.
- Rules are cached in the agent's browser and applied the instant a ticket opens: no flashing hidden fields.
- Preview exactly what any agent will see before you publish.

**Plans**: Free — exports up to 250 rows and 2 field rules. Pro ($19/month) — unlimited exports and unlimited rules.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Install the app and keep the default API URL (or your self-hosted gateway URL — add its host to the manifest domainWhitelist when self-hosting).
2. As an admin, open the Power Suite icon in the left navigation bar once. The app registers your account and stores its signing secret in a secure setting automatically.
3. Use **Advanced Search & Export** to export records, and **Field Rules** to build rules by field name. Agents get rules enforced automatically in the ticket sidebar.
app.description: Cursor-paginated CSV/XLSX export with custom fields, plus zero-flicker field rules by group, role and tag.
